title: festuca octoflora var. glauca
intro: Festuca octoflora var. glauca, commonly known as Blue Joint Grass, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it may exhibit health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Blue Joint Grass include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it a potential remedy for anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
